title: Reproduce and narrow the Core2 native HCI complete GATT failure

execution.environment: macOS Apple Silicon; QEMU m5core2; stock UIFlow2; Bumble external controller/peer

checks.name: native_hci_transport
checks.detail: 11/11 checks including bounded queue and clean shutdown

checks.name: hci_3a_single_c2h_callback
checks.detail: Reset Complete delivered and next H2C observed

checks.name: gatt_service_discovery
checks.detail: Second ATT request followed by HCI process ack returned 12 and HCI Reset

checks.name: qemu_patch_reverse_check
checks.detail: Temporary scheduler experiments removed; native HCI source matches repository patch

checks.name: safe_point_register_audit
checks.detail: Common caller-saved Xtensa special registers were restored, but arbitrary CPU0 callback injection still caused ACK 12 and LoadProhibited

notes: The H4 RX parser and single-packet callback are not the current failure.
The failure boundary is controller-response transaction and vCPU-safe callback context.
Restoring common Xtensa special registers at arbitrary safe points is insufficient; direct nested callback is not a domain-valid notification context.
No QEMU runtime patch change was retained from the failed scheduler experiments.
Physical hardware and bit-exact Espressif BT controller behavior remain unverified.
